## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Evidence type

- [ ] Measured experiment
- [ ] Dated audit
- [ ] Primary-source documentation
- [ ] Architecture inference
- [ ] Documentation/maintenance only

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Baseline verification passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Runner changes include a smoke run.
- [ ] New data includes environment and run manifests.
- [ ] No frozen release data was silently replaced.
- [ ] No secrets, real identifiers, personal data, or production endpoints are included.

## Interpretation boundary

State what the change proves and what it does not prove.
